stories.title: Wales' papers: Reform boycotts Senedd and man guilty of murder
stories.summary: A review of the front page stories from the daily and weekly newspapers in Wales.

stories.title: Free SAD lamps given out as disorder 'makes it hard to do anything on darker days'
stories.summary: Seasonal Affective Disorder can affect mood, energy and sleep during the winter months.

stories.title: 'Summer was a wake-up call, winter could be dire' warning over food supplies
stories.summary: Wales needs to grow more fruit and veg or it will be at the mercy of wars and climate change, one expert says.

stories.title: Welsh NHS bosses call for multi-year health funding
stories.summary: Next week Welsh ministers will unveil next year's draft spending plans for all public services.

stories.title: University's £16m savings will lead to 150 job losses, says union
stories.summary: The university says it has to make "difficult" decisions to save £16m by the end of 2027-28.

stories.title: Tory Andrew RT Davies accuses Plaid ministers of lying to Covid bereaved families
stories.summary: He says the health minister told families a review would be able to compel people to give evidence.

stories.title: Welsh students to start repaying loans earlier after thresholds frozen
stories.summary: The Welsh government said it was "unavoidable" after controversial changes in the 2025 UK budget.

stories.title: Drama about paedophile head teacher cancelled by S4C
stories.summary: The broadcaster apologises for the "distress" caused and confirms the programme will not go ahead.

stories.title: Reform boycotts Senedd after member banned for saying white people are being replaced
stories.summary: Party members withdrew from most of Wednesday's Senedd proceedings over Joe Martin's speaking ban.

stories.title: Drug courier, 19, found guilty of murdering teen with zombie knife
stories.summary: Georgie Mears attacked Tristan Kerr with a 13.5cm (5.3in) blade in Abertridwr, Caerphilly county.

stories.title: 'You makes Barry proud' - Gavin & Stacey star Joanna Page to enter I'm a Celeb jungle
stories.summary: Ruth Jones sends a message from 'Nessa' to co-star Joanna Page as Page prepares for her jungle debut.

stories.title: Fury v Joshua fight faces objections over 3am finish
stories.summary: The fight at Cardiff's Principality Stadium is due to finish in the early hours to align with US primetime.
